# Sell My Company Data

> Sell My Company Data helps companies explore licensing de-identified operational records to AI labs and research teams. Companies retain ownership; scope, permitted use and payment are agreed in writing.

The free calculator is an indicative model, not a buyer offer. It uses published buyer pricing (Handshake AI's data-partnership calculator) by employees, years of operation, country and systems in use. Revenue and industry do not change its result. Final pricing depends on records, volume, quality, permissions and buyer review.

## Sellers
- [Home and calculator](https://sellmycompanydata.com/): estimate a potential licence range and request a conversation.
- [How business data licensing works](https://sellmycompanydata.com/data-licensing/): records, eligibility, ownership, rights and the licensing process.
- [Calculator methodology](https://sellmycompanydata.com/data-valuation/): the formula, assumptions, examples and limits.

## Buyers and referrals
- [Buy business data](https://sellmycompanydata.com/buyers/): submit a data brief for AI research.
- [Refer a business](https://sellmycompanydata.com/refer/): advertised flat $10,000 fee per qualifying completed licence, subject to written referral terms agreed before an introduction proceeds.

## Policies and contact
- [Privacy notice](https://sellmycompanydata.com/privacy/): enquiry and booking information handling.
- [Website and referral terms](https://sellmycompanydata.com/terms/): estimates, enquiries and referral eligibility.
- [Speak with James](https://cal.com/jamesrowdyy/15min): personal 15-minute booking page used by this business.
